scenarios.name: Inspect the context menu for an Origin plane

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
Auto-Resize is enabled for the YZ Plane in the captured session
the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row
a context menu opens beside the plane row
the menu offers New Sketch, Measure, Visibility and Auto-Resize
Auto-Resize is checked in this session
the corresponding plane is highlighted as a blue translucent surface in the viewport
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the plane row and translucent plane remain highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the highlighted plane is no longer displayed
